reviews.title: Worked in my son's laptop
reviews.comment: Expanded my son's laptop, an Asus Vivobook Flip, from the factory 8 gigs to a more usable 24 gigs.  Windows 11 runs much better now.  It saved me from buying a whole new laptop.  Memory booted up the first time and checks out.  Memory cards are practically commodity items these days so it's hard to say if "this" is better than "that".  I will say that this was a good value and quality.  If you've never swapped out RAM in a laptop, check out some videos on YouTube -- getting the case open is honestly the hardest part.  They tend to hide at least one screw under a rubber foot.  Once the case is open, the memory card pops easily into place on the MoBo. Also, make sure that your laptop is, in fact, expandable.  Some come with memory soldered to the board and no spare slot.
reviews.author: CMYK Josh

reviews.title: 16gb Micron Sodimm For Laptop Upgrade Works Well
reviews.comment: Good product at a fair price. This memory card was used to upgrade a laptop so that it would run more comfortably with multiple apps working at the same time. The price was not the very cheapest but at the lower end of what is available and it is made by a reputable company. No problems after a few months and easy install. I would buy again.

reviews.title: Top choice for the Asus Rog Zephyrus G16.
reviews.comment: While my Asus GU603VI technically supports up to 48GB of RAM, I knew better than to go that route. Since the laptop already has a 16GB Micron module soldered onto the motherboard (Slot 1), I opted for this Micron 16GB SODIMM for Slot 2 instead. This creates a perfectly matched 32GB dual-channel configuration, ensuring better-balanced performance for multitasking and overall system efficiency. A mismatched 48GB setup would have left one channel underutilized, making this 32GB dual-channel upgrade the smarter choice.
reviews.author: iScott

reviews.title: Memoria RAM sin fallas.
reviews.comment: El año pasado compré una mini pc de marca Beelink, tuve problemas con el equipo una vez que se venció el tiempo para devolverlo, realize pruebas hasta que consegui que unos de los módulos de memoria ram estaba dañado, me decidí a comprar el módulo nuevo de 16 g 3200Mhz de marca Micrón, escogí esta marca ya que son los mismos que fabrican las memorias marca Crucial, hasta ahora ha funcionado bien la pc, espero comprar más adelante el otro módulo de la misma marca y sustituir el que trajo el equipo inicialmente, que ni siquiera tiene marca visible. La empresa Beelink realmente me defraudó con las memorias que usan en el ensamblaje de los equipos.
reviews.author: Carlos Hernandez
